presentation.globalVisualRule: A4 2D editorial; shared marble/ivory R2 body, navy headlines, gold rules, teal chart accents, no 3D.

WATERFALL_PAGE.grid: full-width primary chart plus right reading margin

RESERVE_COVERAGE.grid: one large coverage block with component columns

GOAL_FUNDING.grid: full-width progress rows, slim date rail

CHECKLIST.grid: full width checklist/table with source status

ESTATE_PREPARATION.grid: two separate columns facts and wishes

SOURCES_METHOD.grid: single reading column with lined records

chartTypeDefinitions.KPI_GRID_4: Four headline metric cards with unit, period and precision labels; no pseudo trend arrows without history.
chartTypeDefinitions.HOUSEHOLD_ROLE_NETWORK: Non-suggestive people and responsibility nodes; no inferred nominee/beneficiary or amounts.
chartTypeDefinitions.GROUPED_BARS: Bars only if at least two comparable, known series/items with shared currency and period.
chartTypeDefinitions.EXPENSE_STACK: Non-overlapping spending-category portions and an explicit unclassified remainder; never invent split.
chartTypeDefinitions.CASH_WATERFALL: Known income/expense/debt bridge, no double deduction; if unknown show component rails only.
chartTypeDefinitions.HISTORY_LINE: True recorded period observations only, with source dates and no implied extrapolation.
chartTypeDefinitions.CURRENT_VS_SCENARIO: Only explicitly saved assumption-driven system results; annotate baseline vs scenario.
chartTypeDefinitions.NET_WORTH_BRIDGE: Assets minus liabilities using same valuation basis; signed result and owner share explicit.
chartTypeDefinitions.DONUT_ALLOCATION: Known additive category ratios only, each with legend, amount and 100% reconciliation.
chartTypeDefinitions.HORIZONTAL_RESERVE_BARS: Separate available amounts from restricted or unknown liquidity classifications.
chartTypeDefinitions.COVERAGE_MONTHS: Coverage months only with valid numerator / expense denominator basis, not assumed essentials.
chartTypeDefinitions.FUNDING_PROGRESS: Goal target and uniquely allocated funds supported by explicit declaration; avoid invented %.
chartTypeDefinitions.DEBT_STACK_AND_TABLE: Debt by type and amount, matched to valuations/dates. Payment commitments separate.
chartTypeDefinitions.SENSITIVITY_COMPARISON: Scenario stress outcome with known assumptions, never a synthetic shock by default.
chartTypeDefinitions.POLICY_ROLE_MATRIX: Owner, insured person, premium, term, covered event, nomination documented separately.
chartTypeDefinitions.EVIDENCE_RISK_MATRIX: Known, estimated, unknown source readiness; not a risk adequacy rating.
chartTypeDefinitions.RADAR_INDICATORS: Only admitted dimensionally comparable, defined, normalized indicator scores, never default.
chartTypeDefinitions.PRIORITY_EVIDENCE_CARDS: Prioritize missing-data review and customer-selected goals only; not regulated recommendations.
chartTypeDefinitions.MILESTONE_ROADMAP: Timeline anchored to explicitly declared milestone dates and user choices.
chartTypeDefinitions.REVIEW_CHECKLIST: Status and source/action receipts, cannot assert a task was completed without saved evidence.
chartTypeDefinitions.DOCUMENT_STATUS_MATRIX: Supported document status by jurisdiction/year, with exact rule approval boundary.
chartTypeDefinitions.ESTATE_READINESS_MAP: Roles, documents and wishes; legal validity and nominee effects not inferred.
chartTypeDefinitions.SOURCE_PROVENANCE: Evidence/digest/units/rule versions without private IDs in shared previews.

globalChartRules.EXACT_SOURCE_SNAPSHOT: All charts, text, inputs share the exact saved draft version and content/evidence digests.
globalChartRules.KNOWN_NIL_IS_NOT_UNKNOWN: UNKNOWN, NOT_PROVIDED, NOT_APPLICABLE, EXACT_ZERO, APPROXIMATE and RANGE are separate states; never manufacture a zero or midpoint.
globalChartRules.HISTORY_REQUIRED: Never invent historical observations, compare-to-last-year % or growth trend from one snapshot; fallback is a current-state visual plus explicit missing periods.
globalChartRules.ALLOCATION_REQUIRED: Pie/donut is allowed only for known additive non-overlapping category amounts, with correct base, period, ownership and currency.
globalChartRules.RATIO_GUARD: No risk meters, ratios or percentage rings with zero/unknown denominator; percentages display numerator/denominator and time basis.
globalChartRules.SHOCK_CONSENT: Do not invent rate rises or job-loss scenarios. Use only user-saved explicit assumptions and deterministic calculated outcomes.
globalChartRules.INSURED_EVENT_SCOPE: Missing policies or insured persons never prove an insurance/protection gap. State documented cover only; adequacy requires additional rule/authority.
globalChartRules.NO_UNLICENSED_ADVICE: Financial-preparation report cannot invent investments, insurance sales, automatic asset allocation, precise tax deductions, testamentary effect or professional suitability claims.
globalChartRules.UNVERIFIED_TAX: Tax pages show document readiness and rule/version facts, not tax payable/deduction or loss treatment without an admitted jurisdiction, year and law packet.
globalChartRules.ESTATE_DISTINCTION: Household relations, nominees, beneficiaries, wishes, legal owners, and Will signing/validity are separate. Missing consent blocks private details.
globalChartRules.CONTRADICTORY_ASSET: A mandatory art asset with baked-in paid wording cannot be used to imply FREE is paid. Free may use approved artwork as a nonmisleading crop/cover only if legible and accurate; otherwise free cover awaits owner-approved variant.
globalChartRules.BILINGUAL_COVER_EXCEPTION: The owner-provided shared bilingual cover is an intentional artwork exception to locale-pure customer UI; renderer-generated English text never contains Chinese and vice versa.
globalChartRules.NO_STATIC_DATA_IN_BACKGROUND: Body background is decorative only. All diagrams and labels are separately rendered from data; never paste sample chart pixels into live pages.
globalChartRules.NEGATIVE_AND_ZERO_AXIS: Show zero baseline, negatives below baseline or as signed diverging bars. Do not paint positive green for negative amounts.
globalChartRules.SAME_MONEY_ONCE: Loan payments and associated interest, rental totals and selected property leaf, transfers and assigned goal balances may not be double counted.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 这份报告属于哪份资料？
readerQuestion.en: Which saved information is this report based on?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 根据客户确认的财务资料生成。
fixedIntroduction.en: Prepared from the customer’s confirmed financial information.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 我现在的钱和责任处在什么状态？
readerQuestion.en: How do my finances and commitments stand today?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 先看收支、净资产与储备覆盖，再辨认哪些数值来自申报、估算或尚待核对的事实。
fixedIntroduction.en: Start with cash flow, net worth and reserve coverage, then distinguish declared, estimated and unresolved figures.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 目前由谁承担哪些经济责任？
readerQuestion.en: Who supports which ongoing responsibilities?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 家庭关系与经济责任相互关联，却不等同于共同持有权或遗产受益安排。
fixedIntroduction.en: Household relationships and financial responsibilities matter together but do not establish joint ownership or inheritance rights.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 目前收入能够覆盖哪些支出？
readerQuestion.en: How do recorded income and spending compare?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 收入与支出必须使用一致的期间与币种；到手收入及偿债项目不能被重复扣减。
fixedIntroduction.en: Income and spending must use comparable periods and currencies; take-home income and loan repayments must not be deducted twice.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 现金如何从收入转为实际结余？
readerQuestion.en: How do recorded cash movements lead to the current surplus or shortfall?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 现金流连接日常生活与长期计划。每笔费用、贷款偿还与实际付款时间都需要各有其位。
fixedIntroduction.en: Cash flow links daily commitments to future plans. Expense categories, repayments and payment timing must each be represented once.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 已有事实显示怎样的变化？我选择的假设会怎样改变结果？
readerQuestion.en: What changed in verified records, and how do my saved assumptions affect comparisons?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 历史趋势只来自真实记录；未来情景只来自明确保存的假设，两者不能混在一张时间线中。
fixedIntroduction.en: Historical trends require observed records; forward-looking scenarios require saved assumptions. Their statuses must remain distinct.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 有哪些资产与负债，真正属于我的份额是多少？
readerQuestion.en: What assets and liabilities are recorded, and what share is mine?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 资产与负债是不同的记录。估值日期、持有份额和未偿本金共同决定净资产的计算基础。
fixedIntroduction.en: Assets and debts are separate records. Valuation dates, ownership shares and outstanding principal determine the net-worth basis.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 资产集中在哪些类别？
readerQuestion.en: Where are my recorded assets concentrated?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 资产类别反映现有持有状况，不代表建议的投资比例。未分类和权属不明的资产必须明确显示。
fixedIntroduction.en: Asset categories describe recorded holdings, not recommended portfolio weights. Unclassified or disputed ownership remains visible.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 目前有哪些资金可以真正用于应付生活变化？
readerQuestion.en: Which resources are actually accessible if circumstances change?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 流动资产、限制用途资金和一般资产价值并非同一种可用现金。覆盖月数必须标明支出计算基础。
fixedIntroduction.en: Accessible cash, restricted funds and general asset values are not interchangeable. Any months-of-coverage figure must identify its spending basis.

topic.zh-Hans: 目标优先级与资金进度

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 现有资源与已声明目标之间有多大距离？
readerQuestion.en: How do assigned resources relate to declared goals and dates?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 只有明确分配给目标的资金才能用于资金进度计算；同一份储备不能被多次认领。
fixedIntroduction.en: Only funds explicitly assigned to a goal count toward its progress. The same resources cannot be allocated repeatedly.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 每笔债务的余额与付款责任是什么？
readerQuestion.en: What balances and payment obligations have been declared?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 贷款余额不是每月开销，月供也不是可以从现金流中再次扣除的独立负债金额。
fixedIntroduction.en: Loan principal is not monthly spending, and repayments already included in cash flow cannot be deducted again.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 如果已选条件发生变化，现有现金能承受多少？
readerQuestion.en: How does the cash position change under explicitly selected conditions?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 没有保存收入下降、额外开销等情景时，报告不应替客户假设事件会发生。
fixedIntroduction.en: Without saved assumptions about lower income or additional costs, the report cannot assume a shock has occurred or will occur.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 已登记的保障覆盖谁、哪些事件和期限？
readerQuestion.en: Who and what events are covered in the available records?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 缺少保单记录，不能自动推论保障充足或不足。受保人、持有人、受益人和保费承担者必须分开。
fixedIntroduction.en: An absent policy record cannot establish adequacy or a gap. Insured persons, owners, beneficiaries and premium payers have distinct roles.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 哪些已知压力和资料缺口需要进一步核对？
readerQuestion.en: Which known pressures and missing facts require follow-up?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 这里首先表达可核实的指标与尚未确认的事实，不以漂亮的雷达图替代有依据的判断。
fixedIntroduction.en: This page distinguishes defined indicators from unresolved evidence; an attractive radar graphic must not stand in for supported conclusions.

topic.zh-Hans: 目标、约束与优先核对事项

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 当前哪些已知事实最值得先确认？
readerQuestion.en: Which known information gaps matter most to the current picture?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 这里记录资料完整性、已申报的时间压力和用户的目标优先次序，而不自动替客户决定投资或保险产品。
fixedIntroduction.en: These priorities reflect information readiness, stated deadlines and customer-declared goals; they are not automatic product recommendations.

topic.zh-Hans: 根据已声明日期的分阶段路线

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 目标何时发生，哪些准备工作需要相互衔接？
readerQuestion.en: When are declared milestones due and what preparation connects them?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 行动时间轴从客户确定的事项和日期开始，不根据模板自动捏造一年、三年或五年的目标。
fixedIntroduction.en: The roadmap begins with the customer’s own milestones and dates, not default one-, three- or five-year targets invented by the template.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 已经完成哪些准备，还有哪些项目待跟进？
readerQuestion.en: Which preparations are confirmed complete and which remain open?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 完成状态应来自真实保存的确认或凭证；未填写和待审项目不应自动出现已完成的勾选。
fixedIntroduction.en: Completion markers require saved confirmations or evidence. Missing or pending items must not appear checked by default.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 相关课税年度的文件和规则准备到哪里？
readerQuestion.en: Which annual records and rule sources are available?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 这一页是报税准备的资料清单，而不是税额或扣除资格的自动结论。
fixedIntroduction.en: This is an evidence checklist for tax preparation, not a computation of tax payable or deduction eligibility.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 重要文件、角色与分配意愿分别准备好了吗？
readerQuestion.en: Are key documents, roles and wishes recorded separately?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 财务资产记录不会自动成为可处分遗产，受养人与受益人也不是同一身份。遗嘱效力须依适用法律独立处理。
fixedIntroduction.en: Financial asset entries do not automatically establish estate property, nor do dependants automatically become beneficiaries. Will validity has a separate legal basis.

readerQuestion.zh-Hans: 这份报告怎样得出，以及有哪些边界？
readerQuestion.en: Where do these figures come from and what remains uncertain?

fixedIntroduction.zh-Hans: 每个结论都能追溯到保存版本、计算口径和资料状态。报告属于资料准备与解释，不代替个人专业建议。
fixedIntroduction.en: Every conclusion should resolve to its saved source, calculation basis and information state. This report supports preparation and explanation, not personal professional advice.

conditionalAppendixRules.notes: No implied bank daily accrual; no double counted repayment.
Tax candidate and cash flow separate.
Do not count selected single-property leaf twice.
Append without shrinking readable core text.
